message.content: Sara Lamnin, the research-selected candidate for Area 2 Director of the Hayward Area Recreation and Park District, recorded that she opposes denying Israel's existence, does not regard all BDS as discriminatory, supports limiting offensive arms sales and settlement funding, and favors responsible investment. She described involvement in World Zionist Congress elections and efforts to redirect settlement funds into education, criticized Israel's disproportionate response and U.S. funding, and stated she prioritizes local responsibilities. The Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club, a county Democratic club whose stated purpose includes supporting Israel as a democratic, inclusive, and secure Jewish state, recorded a general-phase endorsement of Lamnin; a second endorsement entry appears in campaign-claim form. The research identifies her as the strongest candidate in this race.
